messages:
sara_sales: Quick sync 1 Altara (partner) wants a joint POC: Redwood Dedicated provisioned into their AWS account (VPC peering), SSO (SAML), HSM-backed CMK, telemetry export to their Splunk, and a short pricing sketch for bursty startup traffic. Can we do a technical handoff + 30m call tomorrow? cc @ana_partner

ana_partner: Thanks Sara. Must-haves: data never leaves partner VPC, KMS/HSM customer keys, EU region preferred, p90 latency <=150ms, context ~512 tokens typical with occasional 2k spikes. Also need per-tenant audit logs for compliance.

sam_se: I can run the presales. Need sustained vs burst QPS and whether they want warm caches. Proposed plan: 1) sandbox (1 small GPU, NAT + hosted fallback), 2) pilot (2-3 reserved GPUs, local KV cache). Deliverables: ASCII topology, SSO flow, egress diagram, load script, security answers.

sara_sales: They expect sustained ~20 qps, burst ~180 concurrent. Warmers acceptable.

lee_eng: Ops/pricing note: offer 3-month pilot with baseline reserve (50% commit) + burst credits billed at usage with a partner discount (20% first quarter). Dedicated provisioning lead ~8-10 business days; hosted fallback if they need faster start. Telemetry: we can push aggregated metrics and sampled traces; no raw PII.

eng-security-bot: Confirm: customer-managed KMS/HSM supported for Private/Dedicated. SOC2 pack available; eng-security to review questionnaire within 48h.

sam_se: Action items: I'll produce a minimal k6/curl load harness and a 1-page runbook for canary rollouts by EOD.

deploy-bot: Calendar event created: "Altara joint POC kickoff" scheduled 2026-03-24 09:30 PT. Invites: sara_sales, sam_se, lee_eng, ana_partner, eng-security-bot.

sara_sales: Thanks all 1 I'll circulate the 1-page runbook before the call.
